description.zh: 证书识别码。可通过[ListCert](~~452331~~)接口查询。
description.en: The unique identifier of the certificate. You can call the [ListCert](~~452331~~) operation to query the unique identifiers of certificates.

title.zh: 删除证书仓库中上传的pca证书

descriptions.zh:
本接口一般用于删除证书仓库中PCA证书。

### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call the DeletePCACert operation to delete a private certificate from a certificate application repository.

### Limits

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.
